full_text_zh:
[P1] 长大“干什么”
医生
[比] 丽斯贝特·史蕾洁斯 文/图

[P2] 每个人都有可能生病。
生病时很难受，寻求医生的帮助会让你的身体恢复健康。
医生对人体十分了解。
她能诊断出患者的疾病，并根据患者的身体状况判断需
不需要吃药。
身体没有病痛时，也可以去看医生。
医生会为你做一个全面的体检，并告诉你保持健康的方法。

[P3] 手术帽
口罩
橡胶手套
手术服
鞋套
工作时，医生会在日常服装外面穿一件白大褂。
白大褂的口袋可以装笔、纸、听诊器等。
做手术时，医生会穿上手术服，
戴上手术帽、口罩、橡胶手套和鞋套，
确保手术环境干净、卫生。
白大褂
诊疗包

[P4] 医生在诊疗台上给患者做检查。
检查过程中，她会用到许多医学仪器：
能够听到心脏和肺部声音的听诊器，测量血压的血压计，
检查耳朵的外科检查灯，检查喉咙的压舌板，
可以测量身高的身高仪，可以称量体重的体重秤……
电脑能够显示患者所有的医疗信息，医生会根据病情选择
相应的治疗手段。
有时，医生会借助镊子、消毒剂、药棉、剪刀、绷带或
注射器等工具给患者治病；
有时，她也会开出药方嘱咐患者服药。
小镊子 压舌板 听诊器
血压计 外科检查灯
试管 注射器 橡胶手套
放大镜 剪刀 绷带
消毒剂 镊子 药棉
诊疗台
温度计
身高仪 体重秤

[P5] 候诊室很拥挤，现在轮到一个小男孩看医生了。
他和爸爸站起来跟医生打招呼。
“嗨，巴斯，好久不见，你又长高啦！哪里不舒服吗？”
医生友好地问道。“我生病了。”巴斯回答。
“巴斯发烧了，他总是咳嗽，耳朵也有些疼。”巴斯的爸爸说。
“不要担心，先让我来检查一下。”医生说。

[P6] 爸爸帮巴斯脱下衣服，医生用听诊器听巴斯心脏和肺部的声音。
“你的心跳很正常。”医生微笑着说，
“深呼吸，巴斯，这样我就能听到你肺部的声音了。”
深呼吸的时候，巴斯咳嗽了一声。
接着，医生用外科检查灯检查巴斯的耳朵。

[P7] “现在，我要摸摸你的肚子，也许会有点痒哦。”医生用双手检查巴斯的腹部。
“虽然发烧让你的体温有些高，但你的肚子很健康。
这是压舌板，张开嘴巴，让我检查一下你的喉咙。”医生说。

[P8] “我给你开了药，每天吃三勺，你很快就会好起来了。
还有，这几天不能去学校，你需要好好休息。”医生说。
“知道了，医生！”巴斯高兴地说，“谢谢您。”

[P9] 轮到下一位患者就诊了。
一位带着孩子的妈妈走了进来。
她的孩子并没有生病，只是需要注射疫苗。
“嗨，可爱的小宝宝，我们就注射一小针，很快就好了。”
医生说。
女孩的妈妈也安慰着她。很快就打完针了。
一段时间以后，这个小女孩还需要来注射另一针疫苗。
医生在一个小本子上做了标记，小本子上写着女孩需要注射的疫苗。

[P10] 医生接到了一个紧急电话，她立刻前往急救室，
一个孩子正在送往医院的途中。
当有人发生意外事故或急需救治的时候会被送往急救室。
急救室通常设在医院内便于患者迅速到达的区域，
并邻近各类辅助检查科室。
瞧，急救室外是一片喧嚣的景象：
远处传来救护车的鸣笛声，
一个脚受伤的孩子坐着轮椅经过，
还有一位孕妇走来，她看上去快要生宝宝了。

[P11] “孩子，能告诉我你的名字吗？发生了什么事情？”
医生急忙问。
“我叫劳拉，我在骑自行车的时候摔倒了，胳膊好疼。”
女孩哭着说。
医生先检查了她的胳膊，然后检查了她身体的其他部位。

[P12] “护士会给你的胳膊拍一张特殊的照片，它能让我看到你的骨头。
不用怕，劳拉，拍照片一点儿也不疼。”医生说。
护士将劳拉带去拍X光片，妈妈也陪着她一起去。
“胳膊放在桌子上，不要动哦。很好，劳拉！”护士说。
很快，拍好的X光片就被传到医生的电脑上了。
“看，骨头这里有个小裂缝。”医生指着电脑显示屏上的照片说，
“一会儿护士会给你的胳膊打上石膏，这样骨头很快就会痊愈啦。”

[P13] 劳拉为自己挑选了喜欢的绷带颜色。
“真是个勇敢的小女孩！几周之后，就可以把石膏
拆掉了。”医生说。
劳拉与医生道别后，笑嘻嘻地和妈妈回家了。
看见孩子们能够开心地回家，医生也很开心。

[P14] 每个医生都有各自擅长的专业和技能，我们来看一下吧！

外科医生会在护士的
协助下做很多手术。

产科医生可以帮助妈妈们了解
肚子里的宝宝。

[P15] 眼科医生对眼睛有全面的认知，他知道当眼睛不舒服时应该怎么做。

除此之外，还有许多其他科室的医生，比如牙科医生、儿科医生、皮肤科医生……

一些医生做好了随时支援其他国家医疗建设的准备，他们真的很伟大！
full_text_en:
[P1] Growing up, what will I do?
Doctor
[Belgium] Liesbet Slegers, text and illustrations

[P2] Everyone can get sick.
When you're sick, it feels awful, but seeking a doctor's help can get your body back to health.
Doctors know the human body very well.
They can diagnose a patient's illness and decide, based on the patient's condition, whether medicine is needed.
Even when you don't feel sick, you can go to see a doctor.
The doctor will give you a full physical exam and tell you how to stay healthy.

[P3] Surgical cap
Mask
Rubber gloves
Surgical gown
Shoe covers
When working, doctors wear a white coat over their everyday clothes.
The pockets of the white coat can hold pens, paper, stethoscopes, etc.
During surgery, doctors put on surgical gowns,
and wear surgical caps, masks, rubber gloves, and shoe covers,
to ensure the surgical environment is clean and hygienic.
White coat
Medical bag

[P4] The doctor examines patients on the examination table.
During the examination, she uses many medical instruments:
A stethoscope to hear the heart and lungs, a blood pressure monitor to measure blood pressure,
an otoscope to check ears, a tongue depressor to check the throat,
a height meter to measure height, and a scale to weigh patients...
The computer can display all of the patient's medical information, and the doctor will choose
appropriate treatment methods based on the condition.
Sometimes, the doctor uses tweezers, disinfectant, cotton balls, scissors, bandages, or
syringes to treat patients;
Sometimes, she also writes a prescription and instructs patients to take the medicine.
Small tweezers, tongue depressor, stethoscope
Blood pressure monitor, otoscope
Test tube, syringe, rubber gloves
Magnifying glass, scissors, bandage
Disinfectant, tweezers, cotton balls
Examination table
Thermometer
Height meter, scale

[P5] The waiting room was crowded, and now it was a little boy's turn to see the doctor.
He and his dad stood up to greet the doctor.
"Hi, Bas, long time no see, you've grown taller! What's wrong?" the doctor asked kindly. "I'm sick," Bas replied.
"Bas has a fever, he's always coughing, and his ear hurts a bit," Bas's dad said.
"Don't worry, let me check you out first," the doctor said.

[P6] Dad helped Bas take off his clothes, and the doctor used a stethoscope to listen to Bas's heart and lungs.
"Your heartbeat is normal," the doctor said with a smile.
"Take a deep breath, Bas, so I can hear your lungs," the doctor said.
As Bas took a deep breath, he coughed once.
Then, the doctor used an otoscope to check Bas's ears.

[P7] "Now, I'm going to touch your tummy. It might tickle a bit," the doctor said, using both hands to check Bas's abdomen.
"Even though the fever has made your temperature a bit high, your tummy is healthy.
This is a tongue depressor. Open your mouth so I can check your throat," the doctor said.

[P8] "I've prescribed some medicine for you. Take three spoonfuls every day, and you'll feel better soon.
Also, you shouldn't go to school for a few days. You need to rest well," the doctor said.
"Got it, doctor!"巴斯 said happily, "Thank you."

[P9] It was the next patient's turn.
A mother with her child walked in.
Her child wasn't sick, just needed a vaccine.
"Hi, sweet baby, we'll give you a little shot, and it'll be over quickly," the doctor said.
The girl's mother also comforted her. The shot was done quickly.
After some time, this little girl will need to come back for another vaccine.
The doctor made a mark in a small notebook, which listed the vaccines the girl needed.

[P10] The doctor received an emergency call. She immediately headed to the emergency room, 
where a child was being brought to the hospital.
When someone has an accident or needs urgent medical care, they are taken to the emergency room.
The emergency room is usually located within the hospital in an area easily accessible to patients, 
and is close to various auxiliary examination departments.
Look, outside the emergency room is a noisy scene: 
the siren of an ambulance can be heard in the distance, 
a child with an injured foot is passing by in a wheelchair, 
and a pregnant woman is walking by, looking as if she is about to give birth.

[P11] "Child, can you tell me your name? What happened?"
The doctor asked anxiously.
"My name is Laura. I fell off my bicycle and my arm hurts a lot."
The girl said, crying.
The doctor first checked her arm, then examined other parts of her body.

[P12] "The nurse will take a special picture of your arm, so I can see your bones.
Don't be afraid, Laura, taking the picture doesn't hurt at all," the doctor said.
The nurse took Laura to get an X-ray, and her mom went with her.
"Put your arm on the table and don't move. Good job, Laura!" the nurse said.
Soon, the X-ray was sent to the doctor's computer.
"Look, there's a small crack in the bone," the doctor said, pointing at the photo on the computer screen,
"In a little while, the nurse will put a cast on your arm, and your bone will heal quickly."

[P13] Laura chose her favorite color for the bandage.
"You're such a brave little girl! In a few weeks, we can take off the cast," the doctor said.
After saying goodbye to the doctor, Laura happily went home with her mom.
Seeing the children go home happily, the doctor was also very happy.

[P14] Each doctor has their own special skills and expertise. Let's take a look!

Surgeons perform many operations with the help of nurses.

Obstetricians can help mothers understand
the babies in their bellies.

[P15] An eye doctor has a comprehensive understanding of eyes and knows what to do when eyes feel uncomfortable.

In addition, there are many other specialists, such as dentists, pediatricians, and dermatologists...

Some doctors are ready to support medical development in other countries at any time. They are truly great!
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页是绘本的标题页，展示了书名《长大“干什么”》和本章节主题《医生》，并配有医生为孩子们检查视力的插图。
[P2] 本页通过文字和插图介绍了医生的作用，说明每个人都有可能生病，医生能诊断疾病、判断是否需要用药，并在健康时提供体检和健康建议。左侧插图为X光下的骨骼，右侧为一个拿着体温计、感到不适的孩子。
[P3] 本页通过左右两幅插图和文字，介绍了医生在工作时和手术时穿着的不同服装及其作用，左侧图示手术服各部分名称，右侧图示白大褂和诊疗包，文字说明了白大褂的用途及手术时的防护要求。
[P4] 本页通过文字和插图介绍了医生在诊疗过程中使用的各种医疗仪器和工具，包括听诊器、血压计、外科检查灯、压舌板、身高仪、体重秤、电脑、镊子、消毒剂、药棉、剪刀、绷带、注射器等，并说明了医生如何根据病情选择治疗手段，有时会开药方。
[P5] 本页描绘了小男孩巴斯在拥挤的候诊室里，由爸爸陪同去看医生的场景。医生与巴斯和爸爸打招呼，并询问病情，巴斯表示自己生病了，爸爸补充说明他发烧、咳嗽且耳朵疼，医生安慰他们并准备进行检查。
[P6] 医生为小男孩巴斯进行身体检查，先用听诊器听心肺，再用检查灯查看耳朵，巴斯在检查过程中咳嗽了一声。
[P7] 医生为小男孩巴斯检查腹部，并用压舌板检查他的喉咙，同时安慰他肚子很健康。
[P8] 医生为巴斯开药并叮嘱他休息，巴斯表示感谢并开心地离开。
[P9] 本页描绘了医生为一名小女孩接种疫苗的场景，妈妈在一旁陪伴，医生安慰孩子并完成注射，随后在记录本上标记了后续需要接种的疫苗。
[P10] 医生接到紧急电话前往急救室，画面描绘了急救室外繁忙的景象，包括救护车、受伤儿童和即将生产的孕妇。
[P11] 医生询问一名在骑自行车时摔倒并受伤的小女孩劳拉的情况，并为她检查了胳膊及其他身体部位。
[P12] 医生为骑车摔倒的小女孩劳拉进行X光检查，发现其胳膊有小裂缝，并告知将为其打上石膏以促进愈合。
[P13] 劳拉为自己挑选了喜欢的绷带颜色，医生称赞她勇敢，并告知几周后可拆除石膏。劳拉与医生道别后开心回家，医生也感到欣慰。
[P14] 本页介绍了外科医生和产科医生的不同专业技能，通过插图展示了外科医生在护士协助下做手术，以及产科医生帮助孕妇了解胎儿的情况。
[P15] 本页介绍了眼科医生的专业知识，并列举了牙科、儿科、皮肤科等其他科室医生，同时提到一些医生准备支援其他国家医疗建设，展现了医生的多样性和奉献精神。
